name: layernorm
summary: per row r of x[R][D]: mu = mean(x), var = mean((x-mu)^2) (biased), y = (x-mu) / sqrt(var + eps) * gamma + beta, eps = 1e-5 written as an f32 constant

y.why: reference.py returns an absolute per-element bound B as the scale (rtol 1), evaluated in float64 from the exact inputs, with eps = f32(1e-5), A = sum|x|/D, c = x - mu, v = var + eps, s = v^-1/2, g(n) = gamma(n). (1) mean: a sum in any order plus a divide, or a multiply by f32(1/D), gives |mu^ - mu| <= Em = g(D+1) A. (2) c^ = fl(x - mu^) = (c + e)(1+d), |e| <= Em, so |c^ - c| <= Dc = Em + u(|c| + Em). (3) Sum c^2 in any order, FMA or not, within g(D) (Higham Thm 3.1/3.5); the squares' (1+d)^2 cost g(2); the 1/D step g(2); the + eps one rounding with both terms positive; and since sum(c)=0 the shift e adds exactly D e^2, so v^ = v (1 + e^2/v)(1 + theta), |theta| <= g(D+5): rho = (1 + Em^2/v)(1 + g(D+5)) - 1. (4) |(1+rho)^(-1/2) - 1| <= (2 sqrt2 - 2)|rho| <= |rho| for rho >= -1/2 (WolframLanguageEvaluator: MaxValue[{Abs[(1+r)^(-1/2)-1]/Abs[r], -1/2<=r<=10, r!=0}, r] -> 0.8284271247 = 2(Sqrt[2]-1)); rsqrt is budgeted 2 ulp (OpenCL C 3.0 s7.4 rsqrt <= 2 ulp; CUDA rsqrtf 2 ulp) = 4u relative (WolframLanguageEvaluator: 2*2^-23/2^-24 -> 4), which also covers 1/sqrt (correctly rounded sqrt then divide, WolframLanguageEvaluator: ((1+u)/(1-u)-1)/u -> 2.0000001); so r^ = s(1+phi), phi = (1+rho)(1+4u) - 1. (5) P = c^ r^ gamma: |P - c s gamma| <= |gamma| s (Dc (1+phi) + |c| phi). (6) the two products and the + beta, any order or fused, add at most g(3)(|P| + |beta|) with |P| <= |gamma| s (|c| + Dc)(1+phi). B = (5) + (6). For D=200 the dominant term is about g(205) relative (WolframLanguageEvaluator: 209u/(1-209u) -> 1.2458e-5 for the g(D+9)-sized total), so a dropped term (1/D = 5e-3), unbiased variance (1/(2D)) or a missing beta fails.
